dedupe_keys.name: blue book 2026 data on the integrated water service in italy fondazione utilitatis

description: The Blue Book is the annual data compendium on Italy's integrated water service, published by Fondazione Utilitatis, the research foundation linked to the Italian utilities federation. The 2026 edition page read on 2026-09-28 says the volume analyses the global condition of "water bankruptcy" and its implications for the Mediterranean and Italy, the state of governance of the national water service, the cycle of service concessions over the next ten years and the sustainability of investment after the national recovery plan (PNRR), water quality and safety, infrastructure problems such as network losses and reuse, and tools such as satellite monitoring and blue certificates, ending with a governance model built on resilience and efficiency; the complete monograph and executive summaries in Italian and English are linked as PDFs from March 2026. Coverage is Italy. Access is free download; no licence is stated. Caveats: figures are compiled from regulator and operator sources in report form, so tables must be transcribed. It supports capacity planning and drought resilience studies of Italian water utilities, such as loss rates and investment needs. No related Italian water service record is catalogued.
